type_species: Termes flavicolle Fabricius, 1793 by subsequent designation; see Wasmann, 1897b: 150 [designated as type species of Calotermes Hagen, 1858 (an unjustified emendation of Kalotermes Hagen, 1853. This designation is invalid since it was not an originally included species]. ICZN, 2002: 209: All previous designations of type species set aside and Termes flavicollis Fabricius, 1793 designated as type species under Plenary Powers of ICZN.
